metadata.description: A supported account of Leonardo Vitale's role, process and product evidence.

net-now.title: NET NOW
net-now.thesis: The project where UX leadership, player design and React engineering converged.
net-now.context: NET NOW became the defining transition from interface leadership into full-time front-end engineering.
net-now.role: I led front-end and UX work, designed the player experience and participated in discovery and client approvals.
net-now.impact: The team delivered the platform with a newly trained React group in approximately six to seven months.
net-now.next: React became the center of the next engineering chapter.

xbox-one.title: Xbox One Entertainment Apps
xbox-one.thesis: Four Brazilian VOD brands designed for one console interaction system.
xbox-one.context: At Agile Content, the work covered GloboSat Play, SKY Online, Telecine Play and Vivo Play around the Xbox One generation.
xbox-one.role: I designed console-first catalog, navigation and content-detail experiences across the four brands.
xbox-one.impact: The suite demonstrates product-system breadth without claiming sole ownership of collective delivery.
xbox-one.next: The connected-TV work led into broader web VOD systems.

sky-online.title: SKY Online
sky-online.thesis: A complete web prototype that progressed into a real product initiative.
sky-online.context: The prototype defined home, lists, genres, classification and content-detail states for a complete VOD experience.
sky-online.role: I designed the complete prototype screen set and owned its visual and interaction direction.
sky-online.impact: The concept moved forward beyond the proposal stage; exact production dates remain qualified.
sky-online.next: The full-screen-system work strengthened the path toward product and UX leadership.

microsoft-gpa.title: Microsoft / Grupo Pão de Açúcar
microsoft-gpa.thesis: Early Silverlight expertise converted into an enterprise interface opportunity.
microsoft-gpa.context: Visibility from Microsoft technology events led to collaboration on a Microsoft-supported experience for GPA.
microsoft-gpa.role: I combined interface design with implementation thinking across business and information screens.
microsoft-gpa.impact: The project established a recurring pattern: learning an emerging medium and applying it to product work.
microsoft-gpa.next: That pattern continued through streaming, connected TV and React.
